segments.name: Online insurance marketplace
segments.description: Operates an online marketplace that matches consumers shopping for property and casualty insurance with carriers and agents.
segments.evidence: The Company manages its operations as a single segment for the purposes of assessing performance and making operating decisions.

revenueModel.text: Consumers shop free, while insurance carriers and agents pay for consumer inquiries sold as referrals.
revenueModel.evidence: Our services are free for consumers, and we derive our revenue principally from consumer inquiries sold as referrals to insurance providers.

changes.text: In 2023 the company restructured and exited its health insurance vertical.
changes.evidence: In connection with its restructuring and exit from the health vertical in 2023, the Company recorded impairments of a right-of-use asset (see Note 15).
